a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreement only works if we survive two storms in a row, about a 4% chance. Then we both almost certainly end up with nothing. The reserve already holds 4, enough to secure one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. After that I will take nothing more and will operate every round with you so the reserve refills for you. If you also take, the split is random and we may both fall short, so I'd rather we not both grab. Tell me if you see a better plan.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
